name: Homer
tagline: A dead-simple homepage for your services
description: Static homepage dashboard listing all your self-hosted services with live status pings and search shortcuts. Configure everything in one YAML file.
compose:
services:
  homer:
    image: b4bz/homer:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./assets:/www/assets
    restart: unless-stopped
